prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a preschool listening picture-card game
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only; match its flat picture-book rendering, warm pale background, rounded shapes, color polish, and smooth navy outline weight, but do not copy any animal.
Primary request: create one polished wide 3:2 illustration sheet containing exactly six isolated feeling face icons in this exact left-to-right row order.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform warm pale cream background across the whole sheet, with broad empty gutters separating every cell.
Subject: top row, left to right: one happy face with a warm smile; one sad face with downturned mouth and gentle eyes; one angry face with furrowed brows and a mild frown, clearly upset but not scary. Bottom row, left to right: one sleepy face with heavy nearly closed eyes and a small yawn; one surprised face with wide eyes and a small round open mouth, curious rather than afraid; one silly face with playful crossed eyes and tongue sticking out.
Style/medium: consistent flat picture-book illustration for young children; simple rounded face icons; clean solid color fills; subtle paper-like softness; strong smooth navy outlines of equal visual weight; varied cheerful skin-tone-neutral colors that remain visually cohesive.
Composition/framing: rigid 3-column by 2-row grid on a wide 3:2 canvas; six equal cells; each face fully contained, isolated, centered, front-facing, similarly scaled, and surrounded by generous breathing room; clear empty separation and outer margins; no face crosses a cell boundary.
Lighting/mood: bright, gentle, expressive, playful, reassuring, non-frightening.
Constraints: exactly one face per cell and exactly six faces total; preserve the exact ordering; expressions must be immediately distinct and readable to a young child; no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, divider text, logos, signatures, or watermark; no full people; no bodies, necks, shoulders, hands, hair, hats, clothing, tears flying through the air, symbols, speech bubbles, props, scenes, or extra objects; no cell borders that touch a face.
Avoid: frightening anger; fear instead of surprise; pain; crying scene; duplicate expressions; ambiguous sleepy versus sad; cropped faces; adjacent-cell leakage; photorealism; 3D rendering; clutter; artifacts.
